(fenproporex) NOTE. The following terms have been used as ‘street names’ (see p.vi) or slang names for various forms of fenproporex: Pasexes. Profile Fenproporex is a central stimulant and indirect-acting sympatho- mimetic with actions similar to those of dexamfetamine (p.2153). After oral doses it is reported to be metabolised to am- fetamine. Fenproporex has been given as the hydrochloride, the diphenylacetate, and as a resinate. Fenproporex hydrochloride has been used as an anorectic in the treatment of obesity (p.2149) although the use of stimulants in this way is no longer recommended. Regulatory authorities in the EU have called for the withdrawal of all anorectics from the mar- ket (see under Effects on the Cardiovascular System in Fenflu- ramine, p.2156).
